```yaml
name: Auto‑bump openinference‑instrumentation dependency

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  bump:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Get latest openinference‑instrumentation version
        id: get_version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/Arize-ai/openinference-instrumentation/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name)
          echo "VERSION=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Find current openinference‑instrumentation version
        id: current_version
        run: |
          CURRENT=$(grep -R '^openinference-instrumentation = ' pyproject.toml | head -n1 | sed -E 's/.*= ">=([0-9.]+).*/\1/')
          echo "CURRENT=$CURRENT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check if update needed
        id: check
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.get_version.outputs.VERSION }}" = "${{ steps.current_version.outputs.CURRENT }}" ]; then
            echo "needs_update=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "needs_update=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update dependency in pyproject.toml files
        if: steps.check.outputs.needs_update == 'true'
        run: |
          find . -name 'pyproject.toml' -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            sed -i -E "s/(openinference-instrumentation = \")>=[0-9.]+(\")/\1>=${{ steps.get_version.outputs.VERSION }}\2/" "$file"
          done

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.check.outputs.needs_update == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          BRANCH="bump-openinference-instrumentation-${{ steps.get_version.outputs.VERSION }}"
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ steps.get_version.outputs.VERSION }}"
          git push --set-upstream origin "$BRANCH"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check.outputs.needs_update == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: bump-openinference-instrumentation-${{ steps.get_version.outputs.VERSION }}
          title: "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ steps.get_version.outputs.VERSION }}"
          body: |
            This PR updates the minimum version of `openinference-instrumentation` to ${{ steps.get_version.outputs.VERSION }} across all instrumentor packages.
          base: main
          delete-branch: true
```
